title: Streamlining Travel Experiences
desc: The case study proposes an app to simplify travel with real-time flight info and digital boarding passes. It aims to enhance user experience by providing personalized guidance and push notifications for stress-free journeys.

title: Fampay Transaction Analysis
desc: The case study investigates a drop in transactions on Fampay, India's teen-centric financial app. It suggests strategic partnerships and user-focused enhancements to reengage the platform's tech-savvy teen audience and bolster usage.
